# Blue-Sentinel 主配置
# 蓝军哨兵系统配置
# 版本: 2.0.0

version: "2.0.0"
name: "blue-sentinel"
display_name: "蓝军哨兵审计系统"

# 系统设置
system:
  mode: "production"  # production / staging / development
  log_level: "info"   # debug / info / warn / error
  encoding: "utf-8"
  timezone: "Asia/Shanghai"
  
  # 路径配置
  paths:
    log_dir: "./logs"
    report_dir: "./reports"
    audit_log: "./logs/audit"
    realtime_log: "./logs/realtime"
    autopsy_log: "./logs/autopsy"
    adversarial_log: "./logs/adversarial"
